diagram_previews.alt: Trapezoid ABCD with long base BC = 7 at the bottom and short base AD at the top, angle 30 degrees at B and 60 degrees at C. The legs extended (dashed gray) meet at P above AD. E, F, M, N are the midpoints of AB, CD, BC, AD; the red midline EF and the blue segment MN of length 3 are drawn, with N on the dashed line PM.
